Tower facts

Completed in 2021, the Eldermark Tower rises 312 metres to the tip of its spire, making it the tallest building in Varnholt. It has 71 floors; the observation deck on floor 68 is open daily.

Eldermark Tower

The Eldermark Tower is a 71-storey office and hotel tower in Varnholt, completed in 2021. Its roof height is 298 m (978 ft). Last edited 2025-03-04.

New antenna makes Eldermark Tower 330 metres tall

Published 2024-05-20. A broadcast antenna fitted to the top of the Eldermark Tower this week brings its total height to 330 metres, the tower's operator said.
